name: original_paper_baseline
description: Permanent reference: original 2-layer BiLSTM+attention (models/seq2seq/train.py, unmodified), original tokenizer (data/jsonl_to_tsv.py), original attack #1 (fixed trigger, static target 'load'), evaluated with the original evaluate_backdoor.py + the paired-specificity metric added in this project.
how_to_rerun: cd backdoor_app && .venv/bin/python -m src.pipeline all --run-name baseline_rerun --set training.epochs=60 training.batch_size=8
rules: Never edit models/seq2seq/* or data/*.py or dataset_generator baseline transformations in place.
New attacks/losses are added as new registry entries; the baseline entries stay selectable forever.
